title: fix(runtime): the base export serves the base's own document while a .custom override of it is live
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8HidkhJzbWECJnYCJR3RqC2)_
Fixes #29649

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`GET /packages/BASE/export` 在 `.custom` 覆盖已发布时,改为输出基础包自己的那份文档(原样),不再把该项丢掉。
- 为什么改:真实 showcase 启动下,发布一个仪表盘/报表覆盖后,基础包导出少了这一项(#29597 的过滤器引入);#29640 合入后仪表盘/报表已好,但页面、应用、数据集、文档、书籍的覆盖仍会让该项从导出中消失。
- 风险与回滚:只动导出读取一个函数,只在某项声明覆盖本包时生效;回滚即还原 `packages.ts` 这一处。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`(`ownDocumentsOf`)、新 pin `packages-export-base-showcase-boot.integration.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/packages-export-base-showcase-boot.integration.test.ts`,预期 8/8 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `assemblePackageManifest` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`): the per-package layer's items now go through `ownDocumentsOf`. An item that declares it overrides the exported package (the pair's override) is still never exported under the base, as #29563 ruled, but it is now **replaced, in its place, by the base's own code artifact** of the name (`registry.getArtifactItem(type, name, BASE)`, the prefer-local composite slot `registerApp` filled) when the layer lists no own item beside it. Before, it was only dropped, which left the item out when the layer held the override alone.
- New pin `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-export-base-showcase-boot.integration.test.ts`: the #29563 harness (real `HttpDispatcher`, protocol, `ObjectQL` on SQLite) plus the real `MetadataManager` holding the base's code documents as `MetadataPlugin`'s artifact door stores them, which is the shape every `defineStack` host boots with. Per type (view, dashboard, report, page, app, dataset, doc, book) it asserts the base's whole export is byte-identical before and after the published override, and after a restart over the same database; the item is present and equal; no item carries `overrides`; the pair's row is published; and for view, dashboard and report the effective read and the pair's export serve the override.
- Patch changeset for `@objectstack/runtime`.

## Why

ADR-0146 D8 item 3: `GET /packages/hotcrm/export` "carries the base unchanged". The per-package layer merges the registry's items over the metadata service's, one per `(name, package)` slot. A published `.custom` override registered in the registry's bare slot wearing the base's envelope therefore takes the base's slot, and the base's own item is not listed at all. The #29563 filter then left nothing. The #29563 pin stayed green because its boot has no metadata service, so the layer listed both documents.

#29600 (PR #29640, merged as 7dae3b3c while this card ran) takes the dashboard, report and email_template copy out of the bare slot, which closes this card's dashboard and report rows on its own. It deliberately leaves page, app, dataset, doc and book in the bare slot (#29613), and for those five the base export still loses the item. This fix holds the D8 item 3 guarantee for every type at the export door, whatever the registry holds.

## Tests

Measured on a real showcase boot (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase dev -- --fresh`), with the card's reproduction (ensure-customization, draft PUT with `overrides`, `publish-drafts`), counting items in `GET /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/export`:

| tree | dashboard | report | view | page | app | dataset | doc | book | whole base export |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| main b391feb1 | 3 → 2 absent | 4 → 3 absent | 36 → 36 equal | not measured | not measured | not measured | not measured | not measured | differs |
| main 7dae3b3c (#29640, no fix) | 3 → 3 equal | 4 → 4 equal | 36 → 36 equal | 29 → 28 absent | 1 → 0 absent | 4 → 3 absent | 8 → 7 absent | 1 → 0 absent | differs |
| this branch (fix on b391feb1) | 3 → 3 equal | 4 → 4 equal | 36 → 36 equal | — | — | — | — | — | identical, also after a restart (persistent OS_HOME) |
| this branch (fix + 7dae3b3c) | 3 → 3 equal | 4 → 4 equal | 36 → 36 equal | 29 → 29 equal | 1 → 1 equal | 4 → 4 equal | 8 → 8 equal | 1 → 1 equal | identical |

Pin, red first: on b391feb1 (pin alone) dashboard and report red ("expected [] to deeply equal" the shipped item), view green; on 7dae3b3c (pin alone) page, app, dataset, doc and book red the same way, the other three green; with the fix 8/8 green. The export-read neighbours stay green: `packages-export-base-unchanged-per-type.integration.test.ts`, `packages-export-override-declaration.test.ts`, `packages-export-per-package-layer.test.ts` (4 files, 12/12 before the pin grew to 8 types).

## Acceptance notes

- On the same real boot, a published page, app, dataset, doc or book override is not served by the effective read at all: `GET /api/v1/meta/page/showcase_start_here` (with or without `?package=com.example.showcase`) answers the shipped label, and the pair's export lists none of them. #29613 measured `getMetaItem` serving these overrides from the bare slot on a harness with no metadata service; on a real boot the metadata service's copy wins. This is #29613's row-served path, reported there, not touched here.
- Studio's `studio-authoring.package-customize-restore-display` acceptance[4] re-run belongs to the QA seat; the card's own reproduction passes on a real boot (table above).

## Verification

- NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite): `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`, its positive control is pinned to a commit this shallow clone cannot reach.

- An earlier run on e373cc16 caught `check:query-options-erasure` (exit 1, the pin's `as any` driver query grew the test surface 236 → 237); fixed in 51c4d1ee, now exit 0 at 236.

Outside the derivation, also run: `pnpm lint` exit 0 (e373cc16; the later commit only drops an `as any` in the pin); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` exit 0 (51c4d1ee); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` exit 0 on e373cc16, Test Files 530 passed (530), Tests 8520 passed, 19 skipped; the new pin alone 8/8 on 51c4d1ee.
